wholeSceneAssessment: The scene remains a continuous place. Tree canopy and roots frame the left, the workshop occupies the middle distance, and the open curving stone path leads between it and the right foreground bench. The water and softly receding bridge extend the environment beyond the cast.

Cleaner environmental planes improve depth without stripping lushness. The path now offers visual breathing room, while foreground foliage, flowers and the canopy retain intentional texture and framing. Supporting detail does not become an additional principal event.

Warm directional light is consistent across the principal forms, and the softer distant greens and bridge preserve separation from the foreground. The bright fabric, wood and cream face retain their different surface identities rather than becoming one uniformly patterned treatment.

The dominant head/glasses/laptop unit is clear at all inspected widths. The two guest pairs remain two supporting groups, not four independent plot lines. The leaf connects Muse/Grok into one quiet activity beneath the resting moth, preserving the requested parent/kids metaphor without making the moth older.

Visible feet, seated bodies, stools, bench, laptop, table and toolbox occupy plausible supporting surfaces. The restored grip improves the workshop's contact logic. No new foreground guest, floating major prop or silhouette collision that interrupts the reading was found within this lens.
preservation: Three appearances of the same tiny moth remain: foreground coder, workshop builder and tree rest. Large head, compact body, small hands/feet, unequal antennae and established wing markings remain visually consistent with the previously inspected identity reference.
Four guests remain in their two supporting groups; the two workshop stools remain. The bench/coder/MacBook foreground is still exclusive to the personal mascot.
Clawd remains orange plush with both square eyes visible; Dot keeps its blue form and beret. No back-turn recognition regression was introduced.
The current leaf play, dark Muse eyes and flat white Grok ovals remain in the final integrated13 export.
Composition, warm atmosphere and the rich park setting are preserved; correction did not introduce text, a logo strip, new props or a new principal action.

Keep subtle character interactions as close-view rewards. Preserve the current hierarchy rather than making every guest equally legible at420px.
